kind: Directive deliverable navigation and review checklist

items.title: Vision
items.answer_scope: Full-company purpose, users, boundaries, unacceptable outcomes, real human responsibilities and uncertain benefits remain architecture-independent.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Problem framing
items.answer_scope: Alternative work arrangements, operating facts and nondelegable owner inputs remain separate from technical choices; no assumed company jurisdiction.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Evidence map
items.answer_scope: Initial14lanes, disagreements, selected current primary audits and decision trace retained. New07/08 source metadata consolidation active; source locators are not verified claims.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Capability map
items.answer_scope: 46 complete capability contracts and15 F25named jobs route actual artifacts, native services and accepted human/professional/physical work; every outcome remains unimplemented.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Architecture alternatives
items.answer_scope: A/common cases, B/federation and distinct C2/compulsory inquiry compared and attacked. C1/Acompatibility exposed; credible simpler S0 can win on matched outcomes.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Selected architecture
items.answer_scope: Nine logical responsibilities retain control, information, evidence, authority and failure flows; nineteen attributes each; custom primitive and deployment costs explicit.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Agent operating model
items.answer_scope: Temporary qualified procedures select deterministic, workflow, model, human and professional execution according to actual work, consequence and evidence.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Agent organization
items.answer_scope: Persistent department/persona roster not justified. Versioned templates and temporary instances have scoped creation/qualification/restriction/termination; success does not raise authority.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Skills
items.answer_scope: Typed licensed/provenanced manifest plus procedure/examples/tests/helpers, bounded discovery/composition and library-scale selection tests.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Tools and connections
items.answer_scope: Concrete native, search, mail, public delivery/intake, payments, books and accepted human routes with admission, current scope, captures, unknown effects and removal.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Schemas and contracts
items.answer_scope: Foundational canonical consolidation active: full required/added subjects, concrete types/commands/per-edge predicates, composites and acceptance revision binding. Not complete.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Memory and context
items.answer_scope: Originals, working/session/episodic/semantic/procedural and consented preference contexts preserve purpose, freshness, contradictions, omissions, sensitive-copy boundaries and selective forgetting.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Evidence and truth
items.answer_scope: Observation, claim, inference, decision and unknown stay distinct; transitive evidence closure, incentives, missing evidence and current revalidation govern important claims.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Evaluation
items.answer_scope: All evaluation levels, fixed/fresh/adverse/negative/clean controls, complete denominators, stochastic uncertainty, competent calibration, independent roots and evaluator evaluation; no aggregate success score.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Threat model and risk register
items.answer_scope: Seventeen material risk groups and33attack cases retain causes, unknown likelihood, consequence, detection/prevention/containment/compensation/residual/actual owner/escalation; no runtime protection yet.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Permissions and consequences
items.answer_scope: C0–C5 consequence dimensions, actual standing and scoped grants, exact current judgments/parameters/reservations and independent witnessed release; no self-grants or ambient inheritance.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Reliability
items.answer_scope: SQL scheduling, bounded causal retry/leases, exact deduplication, unknown-effect reconciliation, checkpoints, fresh frontier restore, current deletion and actual continuity.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Human operation
items.answer_scope: Intent, exact decisions, evidence inspection, scoped interruption, corrections, taste, finite attention, authentic practice and actual absence/succession performance.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Mission Control and surfaces
items.answer_scope: Ten job-derived surfaces with truthful authoritative projections, latency/failure/accessibility/mobile and uncertainty. Pixel presence was considered but not selected without an operator job; no fictional activity.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Terminal and coding surface
items.answer_scope: Conversation and typed commands join live work, context, diffs/tests, exact approvals, environment, failures, parallel work and recoverable task switching; actual shell remains confined execution.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Economics and capacity
items.answer_scope: Subscription scarcity and money separate; no silent API/credit fallback. Concrete estimated AWS/VPS/S0, infrastructure/services/restores/domains and unknown actual human/professional/attention costs; customer economics separate.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Self-improvement
items.answer_scope: Versioned evidence-led proposals, frozen comparisons, controlled rollout, current-authority rollback and cumulative drift; protection roots and improvement judge cannot self-modify unchecked.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.

items.title: Full implementation plan
items.answer_scope: Final modular repository/process/VM topology, environments, keys, tests/evals, observability, migration/backup/recovery/release;12dependency-ordered final construction stages, all unstarted.
items.validation_note: This is a navigation/completeness checklist, not a reviewer verdict or assurance that all listed subrequirements are substantively satisfied.
